first_time_viewer_summary: Hormonise is presented as a private, revisitable reflection experience that helps people under family pressure clarify what they need, then optionally explore lived experience and share a carefully scoped question. The opening begins inside the interface, so the user and need take several seconds to infer.

timestamped_strengths.observation: Fictional Day 1 history and advice-versus-understanding contrast establish a non-directive premise; the product label and context are legible but the user need is inferred.
User edits 'a little time' to 'a week'; app surfaces tentative interpretation with confirm, reject, and edit controls. Explicitly says voice transcription is not connected.
Community discovery explains why a broad legal result misses the confirmed family-pressure context.
Return visits preserve uncertainty, an argument, and a boundary; no simplistic victory narrative.
Exact audience, alias, question, private-context exclusion, and confirmation are visible before any sharing.
Fictional Ravi response states it was not generated by Meta AI or sent by a person.
Film explicitly discloses absent live moderation and labels Meta integrations as planned and not connected.

timestamped_weaknesses.observation: Starts inside a full interface; the first-time viewer must infer user, problem, and product promise.
Screens contain prepared exchanges and local example rules; no live service behavior is evidenced.
Relevance rationale is presented, but actual retrieval and user correction are not demonstrated as functioning.
The consent path ends at a prepared response; actual publication, cancellation effects, or enforcement are not shown.
Moderation view states permissions/report routing are not enforced; final Meta diagram is a proposal with no model call or failure state.
Burned captions are readable, but small UI copy is hard to inspect in wide shots; static screen holds flatten pacing. Audio could not be assessed.

model_claim_accuracy.evidence: At 02:40, labeled planned integration for dialogue and structured, correctable context; the film says Meta integration is not connected. No working model use demonstrated.
At 00:29 the app says voice transcription is not connected and asks the user to type/edit; at 02:40 the closing slide labels optional speech-to-text as planned. No live transcription demonstrated.
At 02:35 the sample review screen says no report reaches a real reviewer and staff permissions are not enforced; closing slide labels human moderator decision as planned.

top_fixes.failure: Need and intended user are delayed behind interface detail.
top_fixes.replacement: Open with a concise statement naming family pressure, the person seeking room to think, and Hormonise's non-directive promise.
top_fixes.verification: Ask a first-time viewer to name the problem, user, and product after 15 seconds.

top_fixes.failure: Correctable structured interpretation is only prepared/local; no model behavior is evidenced.
top_fixes.replacement: Show one connected, bounded model interaction with input, structured tentative output, user correction, and unavailable/failure state.
top_fixes.expected_result: Demonstrate why the model is needed and what the user controls.
top_fixes.verification: Compare connected and offline runs and inspect the returned editable result.

top_fixes.failure: Context relevance is explained but not shown operating.
top_fixes.replacement: Show context confirmation/rejection and live results with visible sources and reasons.
top_fixes.expected_result: Make retrieval rationale observable and user-correctable.
top_fixes.verification: Repeat under two different confirmed contexts and inspect the result/source change.

top_fixes.failure: Consent preview does not show actual publishing or cancellation enforcement.
top_fixes.replacement: Show exact preview, publish, resulting audience view, private-context exclusion, and cancel with no post.
top_fixes.expected_result: Prove the audience and text controls match actual behavior.
top_fixes.verification: Inspect test group state after confirm/cancel and attempt audience changes.

top_fixes.failure: Moderation screen is illustrative and explicitly unenforced; model integrations are future work.
top_fixes.replacement: Demonstrate role-gated report routing, review status/audit outcome, unavailable-state handling, and accurately labeled live model use.
top_fixes.expected_result: Substantiate safety and Meta attribution claims.
top_fixes.verification: Test reporter/member/reviewer access, routing, and live model attribution in the running build.

blockers: No connected Meta model is demonstrated; Muse Spark is marked planned and not connected.
Voice transcription is explicitly not connected.
No live messages, community posts, group membership, or publishing behavior is demonstrated.
No real staff report routing or enforced staff permissions; moderation view is illustrative.
No backend, authentication, or failure handling is evidenced in the film.
